verses.text: Woe to people who plan evil in bed and are already plotting trouble! When morning comes, they carry it out because they have the power to do it.
They covet fields and seize them, and they take houses too. They oppress people, stealing their homes and family inheritance.
So the LORD says: “Look, I am planning disaster against this family. You won’t be able to escape it or walk around proudly. These are evil times.
“That day people will mock you with a bitter song: ‘We are completely ruined! My people’s land is divided up. He takes it from me and gives our fields to traitors!’”
“So no one will be left to assign land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
“Don’t preach!” they say. “Stop preaching about these things! Disgrace won’t catch up with us!”
“House of Jacob, should people say, ‘Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Is this really how he acts?’ Don’t my words do good for anyone who lives uprightly?
“But lately my people have acted like enemies. You strip the robe and cloak from peaceful travelers returning from battle.
“You drive the women of my people out of their comfortable homes and take my blessing from their children forever.
“Get up and leave! This is no place to rest, because its uncleanness will destroy it with a terrible ruin.
“If someone comes along who speaks lies and falsehood, saying, ‘I’ll preach to you about wine and strong drink,’ that’s exactly the kind of prophet this people wants.
“I will surely gather all of you, Jacob; I will bring together the survivors of Israel. I will gather them like sheep in Bozrah, like a flock in its pasture. The place will be crowded with people.
“The one who breaks open the way goes ahead of them. They break through the gate and leave. Their king goes ahead of them, and the LORD leads them.”
